name: Sliding stone door (grey-box prefab)
notes: A stone slab that slides sideways into the wall (mw-e03.18): the kind of door a hidden button or a puzzle opens, never a hand. 1.5 s to slide its full 1.2 m. No crush: it stops against whatever is in the doorway. Stone, so it shuts out light, smoke and sound while closed, and grinds at 60 dB as it starts.
